title: Automation Trigger Frequency Heatmap
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event event_type=automation_triggered
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H"), day=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats count as triggers by day hour
| sort day hour
description: Maps when your home automations fire across the hours and days of the week, revealing the rhythm of your household.
value: A trigger heatmap surfaces automations firing at odd hours (a sign of a bad trigger) and helps you understand and tune your setup.
implementation: Forward automation events; schedule weekly and render the heatmap to spot unexpected firing patterns.
visualization: Heatmap of automation triggers by day and hour.
grandmaExplanation: It draws a picture of when your home's routines happen through the week, which helps spot anything odd.
